description: Avacyn's Pilgrim, cast this same turn, cannot activate its tap ability ({T}: Add {W}) due to summoning sickness (CR 302.6) - it has not been under its controller's control continuously since their most recent turn began.
artificial_state_elements: Single-player isolation - no opponent, hand, or other permanents modeled beyond what's needed to show the creature just entered this turn.
Turn number/land count are arbitrary scaffolding.
material_characteristics: Avacyn's Pilgrim's only ability requires {T} in its cost, so CR 302.6 blocks it while summoning-sick.
The creature entered the battlefield during the player's current turn (not carried over from a previous turn).
abstracted_characteristics: Choice of mana dork - any creature whose only ability has a {T} cost and no haste would produce the same result.
Board state beyond the single creature.

illegal_actions_to_reject: Activate Avacyn's Pilgrim's mana ability ({T}: Add {W}) - illegal this turn under CR 302.6; it becomes legal starting the player's next turn.

rules_citations: CR 302.6 (summoning sickness restricts activated abilities with {T} or {Q} in the cost)
